concepts.proposed_markdown: Adyen's POS timeout guide separates a confirmed issuer-processing timeout (platform cancellation and `PaymentResponse` `Failure`/`Communication timeout`) from a request timeout that can leave the terminal payment active. A device interaction timeout usually cancels but can instead advance the screen, as with tipping. Missing payment results and request-timeout `Reject` notifications call for `TransactionStatusRequest` before retry, because the original payment may still progress or complete. The guide's 120-second local and 150-second cloud windows describe specific timeout types, not a general safe-retry timer. [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-error-scenarios-pos-timeouts]]

- [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-error-scenarios-pos-timeouts]] — Adyen POS guide (2026-09-15 webpage snapshot) to processing, device and request timeout distinctions, local/cloud durations and status-gated recovery.
